notes: Two «ح»-branches with their own names: two groups, null tail. Jarir's branch has no Abu al-Malih; Ibn al-Muthanna's does («- قال ابن المثنى - عن أبي المليح»).
«قال أبو داود هذا حديث جرير وهو أتم» is the compiler's remark: left out.
Aisha is the last link: she speaks the Prophet's words inside Abu al-Malih's story («قالت أما إني سمعت»).
